facts.business: Chiraharit Limited is a turnkey Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) contractor specializing in water infrastructure for renewable energy (solar module cleaning systems, bio-gas plants) and industrial/agricultural applications, executing projects across 18 states in India and Africa.

segments.name: Water for Energy (Solar Module Cleaning, Bio-gas)

auditor.name: M/s. G.P. Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Stock statements filed with banks not in agreement with books of accounts; work-in-progress valued at sale price instead of cost price leading to overstatement of stock by Rs 77.98 crore.

key_risks: Changes in government policy and subsidy scheme design
Timing and quantum of order awards
Outcome of product development and field trialling
Movements in input and commodity prices
Weather and monsoon conditions affecting site execution
Availability and cost of finance and non-fund-based limits
Changes in tax and regulatory regimes
facts.related_party_note: Investments in subsidiaries: Malaxmi Polymers Private Limited (Rs 132 crore, 66% stake) and Vasavi Building Material Private Limited (Rs 54.39 crore, 100% stake).
